text:
Emily M: Hey team — dropped the first full draft of the product launch post into Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEF. Main asks: quick tone pass, final benchmark numbers, and legal quick-pass on the claims.
Raj P: reading now. main thing: make the benchmark callout clearer — show p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens.
Sarah D: saw the hero image suggestion. can we swap to the horizontal one I uploaded? it aligns with the blog header constraints.
Tim E: pinging with the perf numbers we measured on dedicated: p50=85ms, p95=220ms, tokens per sec=4500 on a 8xA100 pool. attaching log snippet.
Tim E: ```
Perf test run id: run-2026-03-15
p50: 85ms
p95: 220ms
throughput: 4.5k tokens/s
cost est: $0.006/token (quantized opt)
```
Emily M: thanks tim. Raj — can you turn those into a short table/CTA blurb? We don't want a full table in the hero but a compact comparison vs. open-source baseline.
Raj P: yup. suggested copy: "Redwood delivers p95 latency up to 3x lower and 40% lower per-token cost vs. the baseline serving stack". need legal to sign off on the exact numbers.
Olivia L: quick pass: I need to see the baseline source and the test methodology. avoid superlatives like "fastest". claim phrasing recommended: "up to 3x lower p95 latency in our tests vs. the baseline configuration". also need link to run IDs.
Emily M: noted. Tim — can you paste the baseline config and run IDs in the doc? we can append a footnote with methodology.
Tim E: added baseline details in the Drive doc and pasted run IDs in the thread.
Sarah D: CTA design: primary CTA should be "Try Dedicated — 14 day credits" (button), secondary CTA "Read benchmark details" (link to appendix). recommend adding microcopy under button: "No infra changes, same API".
Emily M: love that. marketing wants to route clicks to hubspot with UTMs. Raj, can you draft the utm params?
Raj P: propose utm_source=blog, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=dedicated_launch_v1, utm_content=cta_primary
Emily M: legal okay with the benchmark phrasing? Olivia?
Olivia L: if we use "in our tests" and include methodology link, legal is fine. please add a sentence about "results may vary" in the appendix.
Tim E: added the methodology appendix and the run links. included what we ran and env specs.
Emily M: approvals needed: product (Raj), design (Sarah), legal (Olivia). can each reply with :thumbsup: once final. target publish window is next Wednesday EOD.
Sarah D: :thumbsup: design good from my side. please confirm hero image crop before publish.
Raj P: small nits on the demo flow copy; propose swapping two paragraphs in the middle. :thumbsup: once swapped.
Olivia L: :thumbsup: legal cleared on wording + methodology link present.
Emily M: great — Tim can you schedule the publish in the CMS? I can do final draft edits and send to Lana for SEO checks.
Tim E: scheduling now. draft scheduled for 2026-03-24 16:00 PT. publish-bot will post preview to #all-hands when live.
Maya (publish-bot): Scheduled post "Redwood Dedicated: predictable inference at scale" for 2026-03-24 16:00 PT. Preview: https://cms.redwood.ai/preview/launch-dedicated
Emily M: final checklist: SEO (Lana), hubspot redirect + UTMs (Raj), hero crop (Sarah), legal blurb in appendix (Olivia), runtime numbers linked (Tim). I'll post a final thread reminder Monday morning.
Raj P: I'll prepare the UTM'ed URLs and short link for sales to use in outreach.
Emily M: thanks everyone. closing thread for now unless new blockers. :rocket:
